I ship local-first macOS apps, terminal tools, and AppSec workflows from Istanbul — capture, parallel AI workspaces, private transfer, and evidence-backed review.

## Selected work

**[ScreenTextGrab](https://github.com/batu3384/ScreenTextGrab)** — Swift. Local-first macOS menu bar OCR for screen, code, subtitles, tables, and PDFs.

**[calder](https://github.com/batu3384/calder)** — TypeScript. Terminal-centric Electron workspace for parallel Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity sessions.

**[frostwall-beam](https://github.com/batu3384/frostwall-beam)** — Rust. Encrypted LAN and internet file transfer with pairing codes and receiver approval.

## Operator stack

- **[sift](https://github.com/batu3384/sift)** — Review-first terminal cleaner for macOS and Windows. Destructive work is previewed before it runs.
- **[ironsentinel](https://github.com/batu3384/ironsentinel)** — Local-first AppSec CLI for guided scans, runtime trust checks, and HTML / SARIF / CSV evidence.
- **[falcon-dm](https://github.com/batu3384/falcon-dm)** — Local-only macOS download manager for HTTP, HLS, and YouTube. No cloud queue.
- **[deskward](https://github.com/batu3384/deskward)** — Tailscale-first remote desktop with a Rust core, Flutter client, and E2EE sessions.
